title: How Onesimus, Lady Montagu and a 1721 Boston Count Proved Smallpox Inoculation Worked — Onesimus & Lady Montagu, Boylston's 1721 Boston Variolation Trial (15.0% vs. 2.4% CFR = 84.0% RRR), R₀ Ring-Vaccination Math & 1902 Horsepox/Vaccinia aDNA

teenKit.tldr: Long before modern labs existed, brilliant pioneers like an enslaved man named Onesimus and aristocrat Lady Montagu proved that intentionally giving people a mild dose of smallpox could save them from the deadly virus. Backed by 1721 Boston trial data and modern genetics, this risky biological gamble ultimately led to eradicating one of history's worst apex predators.
teenKit.whyItMatters: It proves that empirical human observation and courage can crack nature's deadliest codes even without microscopes or germ theory, laying the exact foundation for how we protect global public health today.
keyTakeaways: Onesimus and Lady Montagu introduced life-saving variolation techniques from West Africa and the Ottoman Empire to Western medicine long before germ theory existed.
The 1721 Boston variolation trial used hard math—showing a massive drop in mortality from 15.0% down to 2.4%—to mathematically prove the method worked.
Smallpox is the only human disease we have ever completely wiped off the face of the earth, thanks to a combination of historical inoculation and modern epidemiology.

vocab.meaning: The old-school, highly risky process of intentionally infecting someone with real smallpox material, usually through a scratch on the skin, to trigger a milder (though still dangerous) form of the disease.
The percentage of people diagnosed with a specific disease who end up dying from it.
A mathematical measurement showing how much a medical treatment successfully cuts down your chances of a bad outcome compared to doing nothing.
The cutting-edge science of extracting and analyzing ancient DNA from archaeological remains—like old mummies or museum specimens—to track how viruses mutated over thousands of years.

It is the only human disease that humanity has ever completely eradicated from the earth.
It is the only pathogen that originated in ancient Egypt.
